title: [DEV-M] Widget is still broken
body:
tested using a galaxy s10 on Android 10 and a S22 Ultra on android 13 and both will not allow the widget to be show. 

using Dev M Build F905d7b594

comments.body: created an s22 ultra profile in AS and the widget worked in it. Uncertain why it wont in the devices.  Tried with AAPS client and AAPS and both would not show widget
tried s10 in virtual emulator using android Q and the widget fails.
ok.. figured it out.. looks like the opacity is set to zero by default.. adjusting it makes it work in the physical and virtual devices.
